positioning: Post-quantum is no longer rare — several chains now claim it. suwappu-dag is the only one where settlement is both deterministic and joint-quorum-safe: a fork requires Byzantine capture of two independent validator rings at once, and committed state never reverts.
note: Honest capability status. 'Shipped' = implemented, reviewed, and CI-green on the working branch (not necessarily on a live network). 'In progress' = primitive landed or design ratified, remaining work named. 'Planned' = designed, gated on a dependency. Links point at the repo.

items.name: ML-DSA-65 signing · ML-KEM-768 confidentiality
items.note: NIST FIPS-204 / FIPS-203 on the primary signing and confidential surfaces — the only settlement chain with PQ on its primary surface, not opt-in wallets.

items.name: Auditable confidential transfers
items.note: Dual-recipient memo envelope shipped (ML-KEM-768 + ChaCha20-Poly1305, recipient + independent auditor, no key escrow). The zk range/spend proof (Phase 3) is a dedicated crypto sprint.

items.name: Constant-size LTP attestation → PQ
items.note: The classical BLS aggregate is time-boxed (end-2028 sunset) and migrates to a hash-based ML-DSA Merkle aggregate; 'constant-size' restated as O(1)-in-signers.

items.name: Joint-quorum AND-gate (dual-ring)
items.note: A fork requires Byzantine corruption of both the 40-slot Authority Ring and the 200-slot Validator Ring at once (paper Theorem 2). No single ring is a point of failure.

items.name: Fast-path lane · 100% equivocation slashing
items.note: Single-owner sub-second lane with K=4 binding. Fast-path slashing evidence is observability-only until per-signer cert signatures land.

items.name: Round-driver liveness (frontier snap)
items.note: Snap-to-frontier + density clamp fixes the multi-region round-advance stall (PERF-1, consensus-reviewed, CI-green).

items.name: Machine-checked invariant obligations
items.note: Phase 1: Kani bounded-model-checking harnesses verify the joint-quorum (Theorem 2) and LTP 7-of-9 quorum predicates against the shipping code (no model-code gap). The cryptographic-hardness layer is cited, not proven; an unbounded proof-assistant mechanization (Phase 2) is not started.

items.name: Fee abstraction · sponsorship
items.note: Fee-payer/sender separation + ML-DSA sponsorship primitive shipped (dormant — no funds move yet). Mempool→settlement threading + fee-auth nonce/expiry are settlement-PR prerequisites.

items.name: Stablecoin-denominated fees
items.note: Gated on a live registered issuer (a fee token to denominate in).

items.name: Cross-chain settlement (LTP + adapter)
items.note: LTP is the settlement-attestation layer; a thin OFT-class asset-mobility adapter is designed, gated on the end-to-end PQ bridge mint path.
